استحثوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحَثُّوا (istaḥaṯṯū) /is.ta.ħaθ.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اُسْتُحِثُّوا (ustuḥiṯṯū) /us.tu.ħiθ.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اِسْتَحِثُّوا (istaḥiṯṯū) /is.ta.ħiθ.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
